name: Word Count Goal Tracker
author: Divyesh mishra

sections.description:
Word Count Goal Tracker helps authors and bloggers stay consistent with their writing.
Set per-post goals, track progress live in the editor, and view overall progress in your dashboard.

⚠️ Currently this plugin supports only the Gutenberg (block) editor.

Features

  • Set custom word count goals per post.
  • Live progress bar in the editor.
  • Default word count goal for all posts.
  • Word count / goal column in the Posts list.
  • Optional “Goal achieved” notification for authors.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress admin panel.
  3. Open a post to set or view your word count goal.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin change my content?

No, it only tracks word count and goals. It does not modify your posts.

Can I set a default word count goal for all posts?

Yes, you can set a global goal in the plugin settings.
sections.changelog:
1.0

  • Initial release with per-post goals, default global goal, and editor progress bar.
